attractions.name: Eco Park
attractions.description: Nestled amidst dense deodar and oak forests, one of Dhanaulti's most popular attractions. Features well-maintained walking trails, scenic viewpoints, and fresh mountain air. Ideal for families enjoying nature at a relaxed pace.

attractions.name: Surkanda Devi Temple
attractions.description: Perched at an elevation of over 2,700 metres, one of Uttarakhand's revered Shakti Peeths. Offers breathtaking views of the Himalayan ranges. Accessible via uphill walk or ropeway (subject to operation).

safety_tips.tip: It is recommended to visit Cloud's End during daylight hours and avoid the forested sections after dark.

transport_options.description: Drive from JW Marriott Mussoorie to Eco Park, Dhanaulti takes approximately 2 hours.
Ropeway available at Surkanda Devi Temple as an alternative to the uphill walk (subject to operation).

health_tips.tip: Motion sickness medication is recommended for hill roads with winding mountain routes.
Carry a basic first-aid kit and personal prescription medicines throughout the trip.
Use mosquito repellent, especially during outdoor activities and evening hours.
June brings occasional rain showers in the hills. Pack a compact umbrella or lightweight rain jacket.
